title: Carry on after a miss
description: A tracker with pauses and late check-ins. What was done stays in the history, and after a break you can come back to the next action.

blocks.text: A person completed some of their habits, but the day’s total looks almost the same as a complete miss. Feedback like that hides what was done. Another review asks for a pause during illness or a vacation, so that a break doesn’t erase the earlier effort.

quote.text: The only thing I don’t like about the app is that it’s very “all or nothing.” If you complete all of your habits, the circle in the day fills up. If don’t complete all your habits, the circle gets outlined. I’d prefer if the circle filled a little with each habit I complete.

blocks.text: Keep individual actions and show the history for a period. Tell a pause apart from a day that wasn’t completed. After a return, offer to carry on with the old habit or to change the schedule, keeping the accumulated records.

Show a person their own history after a natural break. Can they tell what they have already done and carry on without setting the habit up again? Compare several views of the history: days, the number of actions, and how well their own schedule was kept.
